reviews.author: James Clark
reviews.text: We only use C&M!! Hands down the best towing company in Haywood county. Him and his wife is very nice and respectful! He has respect for anything he tows! We appreciate you Matthew

reviews.author: Stewart L
reviews.text: We cannot say enough good things about Matthew and Sherry. They called right back and were there within the time they stated. Our car was stuck 3000 ft up in the snow with icy conditions. No other companies would help us. They had chains and were ready to get to work. They told us not to worry, this is what they do. And they did. With patience and good humor. They calmed our nerves and charged us a very fair price. They will be on our all of angels now forever. We are so grateful and pleased with their service and joy.

reviews.author: Kisha Clark
reviews.text: Matthew and his wife are the ONLY towing company we use!! He treats anything that he puts on his truck as if they was his own… he is very respectful and very polite. We use him at least 2 times a year if not more!

reviews.author: Rick DiGiovanni
reviews.text: What an incredible job the crew did. I had a U-Haul stuck in a steep driveway, and they did an amazing job getting me out. One of the crew members actually drove the U-Haul through the development in the dark to make sure I made it to the main road. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: A Moc.
reviews.text: DONT GO ANYWHERE ELSE. This owner offers the kindest customer service and BEST price. He truly CARES. I just had the best experience over the weekend and he was so patient and gave the best price after calling dozens of local towers. Thank you C&M!!

reviews.author: Griffin Nagle
reviews.text: Great experience. Was in a pickle with my truck and needed it towed to a garage. Matthew was able to get it picked up same day I called and got it there in the evening after he still had to respond to a different EMS call. Super nice folks and glad they are in our area. Thanks Matthew!

reviews.author: Hollie Lambert
reviews.text: I, 33 y/o F, decided to drive over to Cherokee North Carolina. Which is about an hr and a half to 2 hr drive from where I live. My car started over heating, I did not want to continue driving it running hotter than normal to prevent further damage. I was by myself and very anxious. The gentleman was very professional and put my mind at ease. He seems like an all around really good guy, i did not feel uncomfortable one time riding back to TN with him in the tow truck. Will definitely recommend to friends and family if they're in the area!

reviews.author: laura worgan
reviews.text: Johnny on the spot. Quick reasonably priced. Saved me in very difficult situation. It took talent to get my Audi SUV towed out. Lovely local people. I usually do not spend the time to recommend businesses but they were SO great that I would highly recommend them. Never use any other service but them. Honest, quick and the quality and knowledge was impressive.

reviews.author: Amber Troxell
reviews.text: My husband and I were traveling through and ended up stranded on 40 with a flat tire. After calling several places we finally lucked out and C&M headed out to come tow us. He and his wife were so kind and helpful as we had no idea where we were! They called several places in 2 counties looking for a tire for our Italian car. They towed us where we needed to go! They were reliable, trustworthy and reasonable ably priced. Really good people- We highly recommend calling them for services.

reviews.author: Joshua Gibson (Nonsense Gaming)
reviews.text: We had a tire blowout on our way back home on I-40W at 3 in the morning and after calling our insurance and them finding a service 45 minutes out at an extortionate price. we Googled local services and found C & M who was about 20 minutes from our location and he came and helped us get back on the road until we made it to a tire shop back home. If you're stranded and need assistance in the Maggie Valley area, this is the guy you want. Great man, God bless.

reviews.author: Laura Sullivan
reviews.text: C &M Towing and Recovery went above and beyond a tow company. I was in a bind and didn't have the money on me to tow my truck which broke down and left me stranded on the bypass for 3 hrs. They came to my rescue when I explained my situation and how long I had been stranded. They came and got me off the side of the road and brought me to my home and allowed me to pay what I had and the rest the next day. Matthew and his wife are awesome! I RECOMMEND THEM TO ANYONE!!!

reviews.author: Yasmin Sultan
reviews.text: Matthew was amazing and helped us in a very precarious situation! He answered immediately and was very pleasant and even FaceTimed with me to see how he could help. He came out to the remote cabin we were staying in very quickly and was so pleasant and professional! And he was very reasonably priced! All in all, highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Allison Burnett
reviews.text: C&M Towing is an amazing, customer service-oriented, caring, and professional family-owned business. They quickly rescued us from the side of the road with a flat tire. They were able to get enough air in the tire to get us back on the road and drove behind us all the way to the nearest tire shop to be safe. For saving our butts, C&M Towing charged us an extremely reasonable rate and demonstrated integrity and kindness on top of all that. Highly recommended!!!!

reviews.author: Luke Edwards
reviews.text: Woke up to two flat tires on top of a mountain at a vacation rental on a Sunday morning. C&M arrived quickly to a difficult location and got us to a shop at a very reasonable price. Couldn’t have had a better experience wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them

reviews.author: Atg Productions Msmusic
reviews.text: Nice Folks. They did a good job. Reasonable Prices. Definitely my new go to towing folks in our area.

reviews.author: Jeff McAlear
reviews.text: C&M towing was truly a life saver. My wife and I took my son, daughter in law to look at a piece of property that they recently broke ground on near cataloochee valley in NC. As we worked our way up the mountain the conditions went from sketchy to bad. Once we reached our destination I was attempting to turn my F-150 4x4 around so that we could go back down the mountain. Fortunately while I was turning around all 3 passengers were outside the vehicle. As I maneuvered the vehicle it began to slide down hill down the road. The truck slid off the road and was only stopped from tumbling down a steep hill by a single bolder which caught the right front tire. The truck was literally teetering with the left rear wheel 1 1/2 foot of the ground. And the rest of the truck over the steep slope. We then were all in sub freezing temperatures with no where to shelter while day turned to night. After calling 911 we made several calls to towing companies, all of which were unable to help with the exception on C&M towing. Even though they had other jobs in front of us they put us first due to the extreme risk of cold exposure. They arrived at our location in short order and proceeded to get my vehicle back on the road bed. They then used web straps tied to the rear of my vehicle and slowly crawled/coasted our tied together vehicles back down the mountain, the whole ordeal took about 3 hours. Thank you C&M, they are awesome caring people who know their business. Also thank you to the other customers who had to wait on us. Our dire situation was potentially life threatening, and certainly a foolish endeavor to start with. I learned many painful lessons. I thank god for the safe outcome and thank god for C&M towing.

reviews.author: Lisa Rhodarmer
reviews.text: Just got dropped off by C and M towing at my car dealership in Waynesville. I had a flat tire in Asheville and called roadside assistance. It was going to be 2.5 hours before they arrived. I then called C and M. They were there super fast. They were also professional, courteous, and reasonably priced. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Brittany Jones
reviews.text: A 26 foot moving truck stuck on a road/ off the road, it didn't fit on, (wrong road.) After dispatched from sheriff's office called numerous places, & no one would come up that road, these guys answered and not only arrived within 20 minutes, but showed up with high positive energy, unstuck the truck and at an excellent price! Would recommend to everyone!

reviews.author: Lauren Ryan
reviews.text: C & M Towing went out of their way to provide excellent service and even made a second visit to make sure that I was able to pull out of a rut. The owner is friendly, knowledgeable, and professional, and I knew from the start that I was in good hands. I highly reccomend this company, and if I ever need roadside assistance again, I know exactly who I will call. Thank you, C & M Towing!

reviews.author: Cody Nelson
reviews.text: Best towing service that I’ve received. Awesome pricing, great customer service, and they were super helpful. I gave them a hug for their help in my tough time. I definitely recommend you do business with them! I’m very grateful for them!

reviews.author: Caitlyn Allison
reviews.text: Since I first used this towing service a couple years ago I haven’t used another. We have a lawn care business with mowing trucks/trailers and lots of personal vehicles that unfortunately love the mechanic shop so we’ve had to use them a few times! Would 100% recommend

reviews.author: Yolanda Riffe
reviews.text: They were awesome, didn’t have to wait long they came out quickly and brought my car back to me. Couldn’t ask for better service. I highly recommend them. Oh they also did this on a holiday weekend.

reviews.author: Jessica Bryant
reviews.text: We’ve used Matthew to tow several vehicles for our family and for my older mom. They are a local family business and such nice people, professional and helpful. If you are in need of roadside assistance of any sort I’d highly recommend them!! Very reasonable and responsive.

reviews.author: john kowal
reviews.text: This man will go where no one else will, when my truck was broken down at the top of Cataloochee in a snow storm he was the only wrecker even willing to come up. He went above and beyond to make sure we got my truck off that mountain safely and without doing any damage as it was locked in 4x4. I can't thank them enough for all their help, if you need a tow call C&M.

reviews.author: Elise Nance
reviews.text: I was stuck at Cataloochee ski resort and they were the only towing company willing to come and get me! Brought me down safely, they know what they’re doing!

reviews.author: Marie Beck
reviews.text: Matthew and his wife were lifesavers. Pulled our SUV out of a ditch in the middle of a snowstorm with expertise.Thank yall!!

reviews.author: Mark Conard
reviews.text: I’ve called them every time I had a problem been life long friends with the owner and you can’t ask for any better service they don’t try to break you up with their prices the treat your property with respect they do what they say when they say they’ll do it and it’s done with professionalism I recommend them to anyone I know and I do with confidence.

reviews.author: Mami Muti
reviews.text: Mr Matthew from C&M Towing company was amazing,very punctual,very safe in loading the vehicles,very nice and honest people and price was very fair, I highly recommend them for sure.Thank you, thank you, thank you.10*stars from me.

reviews.author: Kalee Cambray
reviews.text: He was super kind and friendly. He saved our day and even made sure we got to where we needed safely by following us.

reviews.author: Marilynn South
reviews.text: Very, very timely response and extremely professional. Made sure a hotel was available for us and got us where we needed to be. Friendly and good value

reviews.author: Jenna K
reviews.text: Quality. Price. Customer service. These are the things most important in a business and these guys do it all RIGHT.

reviews.author: Jerry Robin Nester
reviews.text: Thank you so much for getting me safely to the motel and providing me with a mechanic that knew what he was doing and got my vehicle fixed so I could get back home!
